intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both sit in {{cityA}}, but they train managers for different kinds of work. This page compares their recorded {{course}} fees, placements, admission routes and campus setting, using our database and official pages we opened in {{year}}.

IIM Ahmedabad vs MICA is not a single winner. IIM Ahmedabad is the general management PGP with a CAT route and the top NIRF 2025 Management rank. MICA is a communications and marketing school that adds MICAT to CAT, XAT or GMAT.

sections.heading: IIM Ahmedabad vs MICA for MBA / PGDM: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose IIM Ahmedabad if you want a two-year general management PGP, a CAT-only admission route and the wider recruiter mix that comes with the top NIRF Management rank.
Choose MICA if your aim is marketing, brand or media work. Its flagship PGDM-C is built around communications, and the interview shortlist also uses MICAT, not CAT alone.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip short or executive courses such as IIM Ahmedabad's Faculty Development Programme of ₹76,700, which is not PGP tuition.

For IIM Ahmedabad our records still list ₹13.25 lakh as a year fee on several MBA-labelled programmes, and there is no single PGP/MBA flagship row. Treat ₹13.25 lakh as one year's recorded figure, not a confirmed two-year total, until the institute's current PGP fee notice is checked.
For MICA our records show ₹13 lakh a year as tuition for the PGDM in Communication Management. Certificate courses in the same database go as low as ₹49,500 and are not the flagship fee.
MICA's official admissions page lists an indicative two-year residential fee of about ₹29.50 lakh for PGDM-C, marked as subject to change. Confirm the current fee circular before you budget.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: IIM Ahmedabad's recorded 2025 figures on this page are an average package of ₹35.50 lakh and a highest package of ₹110 lakh. These are historical batch outcomes, not a salary promise.

MICA's latest recorded year here is 2023, with an average of ₹20 lakh and a highest of ₹36 lakh. The years are not the same, so the two packages should not be read as a head-to-head for the same graduating class.
If you are comparing offers, use the latest official placement report from each institute and match the programme name, not an executive or certificate batch.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: IIM Ahmedabad's PGP shortlist is through CAT, followed by its written test and interview. A bachelor's degree is required; category-wise CAT cut-offs and the exact academic rating are published each year on the PGP admissions page.
MICA asks for CAT, XAT or GMAT, plus MICAT, and then a group exercise and personal interview. You can apply to PGDM-C, the general PGDM, or both, as set out in MICA's admissions note.
Eligibility wording can change by cycle. Use the current official admission brochure rather than last year's cut-off stories.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in Ahmedabad, Gujarat. IIM Ahmedabad is at Vastrapur; MICA is a residential campus in the city, with hostel and mess included in the indicative PGDM-C fee quoted on its admissions page.
If you want to stay in Ahmedabad, the choice is less about the city and more about the classroom: a general management PGP versus a communications-focused PGDM.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: If you want a general management MBA, a CAT-centred process and the strongest recorded placement year on this page, IIM Ahmedabad is the better fit.

If you want marketing, brand or media work and are ready for MICAT as well as CAT, XAT or GMAT, MICA is the more direct choice, even though its recorded 2023 package is lower and older than IIM Ahmedabad's 2025 figures.
If fees are the only filter, do not use the lowest number in our raw rows. Check each official fee notice for the exact programme and batch you will join.

faqs.question: Which is better in 2026, IIM Ahmedabad or MICA?
faqs.answer: It depends on the programme you want. IIM Ahmedabad is the stronger general management PGP on NIRF 2025 Management rank and on the 2025 placement figures we hold. MICA is the better fit if you want a communications and marketing PGDM and will take MICAT.

faqs.question: What are the recorded fees for IIM Ahmedabad vs MICA?
faqs.answer: Our records list ₹13.25 lakh as a year fee for several IIM Ahmedabad MBA-labelled programmes, and ₹13 lakh a year as tuition for MICA's PGDM in Communication Management. MICA's official page quotes an indicative two-year residential fee of about ₹29.50 lakh for PGDM-C. Confirm both official notices before you decide.

faqs.question: Does MICA accept CAT, or only MICAT?
faqs.answer: MICA uses CAT, XAT or GMAT along with its own test, MICAT, and then a group exercise and interview. CAT alone is not enough for the MICA PGDM-C or PGDM shortlist.

faqs.question: How do placements compare for IIM Ahmedabad and MICA?
faqs.answer: In our records, IIM Ahmedabad's 2025 average is ₹35.50 lakh and the highest is ₹110 lakh. MICA's latest recorded year here is 2023, with an average of ₹20 lakh and a highest of ₹36 lakh. These are historical figures from different years, not a guarantee for the next batch.

faqs.question: Are IIM Ahmedabad and MICA in the same city?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both are in Ahmedabad, Gujarat. IIM Ahmedabad is at Vastrapur. MICA is a residential campus in the same city, so the move is about the programme, not a change of city.

faqs.question: Should I treat this comparison as a final admission decision?
faqs.answer: No. Fees, eligibility and placements change by year and by programme. Verify the current official fee notice, admission brochure and placement report of each institute before you apply.
